text.title: Post Migration Cleanup Output Contract
text.summary: Draft-07 JSON Schema for the cleanup checklist: cutover date and parity window, the reconciliation report behind the legacy-write deletion, the zero-traffic counter behind the read-path deletion, every migration flag with its removal PR, every shim with consumers and a date or counter, the snapshot and zero-hit reference scan before the schema drop, the docs search before and after, every alert and dashboard retargeted or deleted, every legacy resource decommissioned with its cost, and per-item tickets for anything past the deadline. Validator: `scripts/validate-post-migration-cleanup.py`.

section.title: JSON Schema (draft-07)
section.note: What the schema cannot express and the reviewer checks by hand: `parity_window` starts on or after `cutover_date` and `cleanup_deadline` is at most `delivery_cycle_days` after `parity_window.end` (r-cleanup-deadline-from-cutover); `snapshot.retention_until` is on or after the checklist's next review date (r-legacy-schema-dropped-after-backup-and-reference-scan); every flag key introduced for the migration appears in `flags`, every shim in `shims`, every alert, dashboard, SLO and synthetic check on the legacy path in `observability`, and every legacy resource in `infrastructure`; any item not deleted by the deadline appears in `deferred_items` (r-migration-flags-removed-from-code, r-compat-shims-listed-with-expiry, r-alerts-dashboards-and-infra-decommissioned).

example.note: Subject violations: a two-day parity window with 17 mismatches and the legacy write merely flagged off (r-dual-write-retired-after-parity); a read path deleted with no counter and no zero window (r-legacy-read-path-deleted-at-zero-traffic); a flag frozen rather than deleted (r-migration-flags-removed-from-code); a retained shim with no consumer, date or counter (r-compat-shims-listed-with-expiry); a DROP in the same PR as the code deletion with no snapshot and a three-hit scan over one repository (r-legacy-schema-dropped-after-backup-and-reference-scan); nine stale doc hits outside the archive (r-docs-and-runbooks-refreshed); a replica still running with no reason or end date and no alert inventory (r-alerts-dashboards-and-infra-decommissioned); a 90-day cycle and a deadline eight months out (r-cleanup-deadline-from-cutover); and a drop executed and approved by the agent.

antipattern.description: `dual_write.mismatches` above 0, `consecutive_days_zero_mismatch` below 7, `legacy_write_removed_by` anything but `code_deletion`, or no `reconciliation_report_url`.
antipattern.reason: r-dual-write-retired-after-parity: cutting the safety net before a real week of traffic turns divergence into data loss.

antipattern.description: `legacy_read_path.zero_for_days` below 7, `includes_batch_window` false, or a `counter_name` that is not a real metric or route count.
antipattern.reason: r-legacy-read-path-deleted-at-zero-traffic: "nobody uses it" is a belief until a counter says so.

antipattern.description: A flag with `key_deleted_from_flag_service` false or `branches_collapsed` false, or a migration flag absent from `flags`.
antipattern.reason: r-migration-flags-removed-from-code: a flag that is always true is a dormant branch waiting to be flipped.

antipattern.description: A `retained` shim with an empty `consumers` list or with neither `removal_date` nor `consumer_counter`; a shim with no consumers not deleted in this cleanup.
antipattern.reason: r-compat-shims-listed-with-expiry: the undated shim is still there five years later.

antipattern.description: `separate_change_from_code_deletion` false, no `snapshot.url` with a retention date, `reference_scan.hits` above 0, or `query_log_searched` false.
antipattern.reason: r-legacy-schema-dropped-after-backup-and-reference-scan: a DROP cannot be rolled back by a redeploy.
r-docs-and-runbooks-refreshed: stale runbooks are the incident procedure being wrong when it is used.

antipattern.description: A legacy alert, dashboard, SLO or synthetic check absent from `observability`; a resource with `still_running` true and no `reason` and `end_date`; no `monthly_cost_removed`.
antipattern.reason: r-alerts-dashboards-and-infra-decommissioned: idle infrastructure keeps its credentials and its unpatched OS.

antipattern.description: `delivery_cycle_days` above 30, a `cleanup_deadline` beyond one cycle after the parity window, or an undone item missing from `deferred_items` with a ticket and owner.
antipattern.reason: r-cleanup-deadline-from-cutover: the team disperses within weeks and the half-migrated system becomes permanent.

antipattern.description: `drop_or_decommission_executed_by_agent` true, or `approved` with no reviewer having read the snapshot and scan.
antipattern.reason: Human checkpoint in `03-failure-modes.xml`: a named human reads the snapshot URL and the scan result before any DROP runs.

text.reference: Stdlib-only validator for this contract; `--self-test` runs both examples above.
Cleanup checklist skeleton with the same sections and field names.
